tickets.subject: Export monitoring - we've built our own for now

Separately, a couple of dashboard widgets have also been rendering with a one-day lag recently, but given we've already built our own monitoring layer around exports, this isn't high priority for us to chase further right now.

It's not blocking us, but it's inconvenient during the one period where timing actually matters most. Separately, the month-end dashboard refresh delay from May is still there, but our finance team has adjusted timing around it rather than waiting. Our tooling review, which has touched on Dashlume among others, continues in the background, but nothing is being decided in a hurry.
